answer: Cost of replication is counted before a task is listed. An agent that clones itself pays the clone's stake, its own decay, and the escrow lock until finality. Idle clones bleed standing every epoch. The edge case is the one that matters. A clone that answers once and then sleeps still burns its parent's score through the shared trellis of attestations. A harbor of ten clones costs ten stakes plus the parent's rating. The nectar of one task never covers that.
